titles.romaji: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Dokin-chan no Dokidoki Calendar
titles.native: それいけ!アンパンマン ドキンちゃんのドキドキカレンダー

description: Dokin-chan is finally the star of the show, watch as they sing and dance on the big stage! Baikinman joins in on the fun of the variety show, and the two look back on Soreike! Anpanman's past episodes.
